_help: Hand corrections, by Wikidata id. Keys: exclude (true) or include (true: add an item Wikidata classes otherwise), lat/lon (real wreck site), depth (m, negative), heading (bow, degrees clockwise from north), fam (generic model family), note. Always give the reason and a source.

Q2004262.note: Memorial built over the wreck of Q506022 (USS Arizona).
